hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the counterpart vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta for accounting. Native concentrated liquidity positions and donations are blocked.
